name: Unraveling Fleshwarp
disable: DC 30 Arcana check (trained) or DC 30 Occultism check (expert) to disrupt the magic, or Dispel Magic (6th rank, DC 28) to counteract the fleshwarping

items.name: Perforate
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches the dam

---
Effect The triggering creature must attempt a DC 32 Fortitude save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to the effects of warpline hazards for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure Strips of the creature's flesh peel away, exposing muscle and bone. The creature takes 3d10+14 slashing damage and suffers a –4 circumstance penalty to Acrobatics and Athletics checks for 1 day.

Critical Failure As failure, except the penalty to Acrobatics and Athletics checks lasts for 1 week.

text: A surge of fleshwarping magic causes a creature's flesh to unravel.
